Continent.description: A continent is a large geographical area that is separated from other continents by water.

Country.description: A country is a geographical entity that is part of a region and a continent.

Place.description: A place where people live or work.

Region.description: A geographical region, such as a country, state, or city.

Visit.description: A node representing a visit made by a person to a place.

_Bloom_Perspective_.description: A node representing a Bloom perspective with properties including version, roles, data, name, and ID.

LOCATED_AT.description: A relationship indicating where a visit took place.

PART_OF.description: A relationship between a place and a region, which is a part of a country, which is part of a continent.

PERFORMS_VISIT.description: A relationship indicating that a person performed a visit.

VISITS.description: A relationship between a person and a place where the person visited the place.

Continent.name.description: The name of the continent, e.g., Asia, Europe, Africa.

Place.homelocation.description: The geographical coordinates of the place.

Place.type.description: The type of place (e.g., house, apartment, park).

Place.id.description: A unique identifier for the place.

Visit.duration.description: The duration of the visit in minutes.

Visit.starttime.description: The start time of the visit.

Visit.id.description: A unique identifier for the visit.

Visit.endtime.description: The end time of the visit.

_Bloom_Perspective_.version.description: The version of the Bloom perspective.

_Bloom_Perspective_.roles.description: The roles associated with the Bloom perspective.

_Bloom_Perspective_.data.description: The data associated with the Bloom perspective.

_Bloom_Perspective_.name.description: The name of the Bloom perspective.

_Bloom_Perspective_.id.description: The unique identifier of the Bloom perspective.

VISITS.duration.description: The duration of the visit in seconds.

VISITS.starttime.description: The start time of the visit.

VISITS.id.description: A unique identifier for the visit.

VISITS.endtime.description: The end time of the visit.
